plain: The gap between the end of one ruler's reign and the start of the next

webster.text: The time in which a throne is vacant, between the death or abdication of a king and the accession of his successor.

example.quote: He suggested a biennial election of the Executive at the time of electing the 1st. branch, and the Executive to hold over, so as to prevent any interregnum in the administration.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, July 19, 1787
